2558-4659-6277--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-4659-6277--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

3360-6006-7008.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Torchling by paying {R}, untapping it.
Repeat.

728-6553-8207.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

81-512-2085.easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
81-512-2085.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
81-512-2085.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4881-6909-7040-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7040-8200.easyPrerequisites: Psychic Paper is attached to Carnage and has "Goblin" chosen
4881-6909-7040-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

4311-5078-7730-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2744-4153-5641.notablePrerequisites: Basking Broodscale does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2744-4153-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.
Activate Basking Broodscale's adapt ability by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-4772-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

104-5086-5183-5231-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-5086-5183-5231-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1895-3330-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-3330-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1987-3110-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3110-5913.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3110-5913.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-527-4460.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-1563-1849-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-1849-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1603-2523-2869.description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Evil Twin dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Evil Twin that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Evil Twin token instead.
1603-2523-2869.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

676-2450-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-2450-4050-7639.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Magnus the Red.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-7295.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-7295.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

3177-3259-3478--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3177-3259-3478--85--106.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

38-659-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-7175.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

1978-4306-7170.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
1978-4306-7170.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Living Brain.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4369-4659-6466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-4659-6466.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Shocking Sharpshooter triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Shocking Sharpshooter triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Shocking Sharpshooter triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2762-4659-6753.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

955-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

478-6871-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
478-6871-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping White Lotus Tile and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

659-2024-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
659-2024-4050.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Goblin tokens, adding {2}{G}{W}
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Krenko and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2350-2421-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
997-5972-6054.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

1460-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to produce at least {3}{U} between Vault of Catlacan and up to one additional land.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
1460-2196-2821-5803.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan and up to one other land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Vault of Catlacan and up to one other land.
Activate Vault of Catlacan and up to one other land by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

2781-2955-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
2781-2955-4605.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

914-3036-4359.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-4359.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

3821-4790-5149.notablePrerequisites:
Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
3821-4790-5149.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
If the up to five lands can tap to produce at least {5}, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

3094-4241-4784.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of Order.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
You control a creature that can attack this turn.
3094-4241-4784.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Lithoform Engine to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Move to your combat phase, and declare any creature you control as an attacker, triggering Augusta.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Augusta's ability.
Resolve the copy of Augusta's ability, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

914-1801-3198.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1801-3198.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Lore Drakkis's mutate ability triggers, returning String of Disappearances from your graveyard to hand.
Cast String of Disappearances by paying {U}, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lore Drakkis to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {1}{U}{U/R}{U/R}{R}.
Repeat.
